source_status: JKR standard section reproduced in producer catalogues (G-CAST 2020; OKA 2018); PRT-M is an OKA producer modification

sources.producer: Cast Concrete Sdn Bhd (G-CAST), Kuala Lumpur

sources.title_original: OKA Prestressed (Pretensioned) T-Beams / M-Beams brochure (March 2018 on sheet)
sources.producer: OKA Concrete Industries Sdn Bhd, Ipoh
sources.content: Same PRT section drawing (scan); PRT1-3 A and hw; PRT-M depths, hw, area range

geometry_notes: Beam has no bottom flange; the 300 mm web runs to the soffit. No soffit chamfer is shown on either drawing.
Printed areas close exactly for PRT1-3 (458350/488350/503350 mm2).

PRT-M rows are not individually tabulated. They are built with the PRT top and 300 mm web; hw = H - 195 matches the printed hw list for all seven depths and the printed area range endpoints (518350 at 1450, 623350 at 1800) are reproduced exactly. Provenance transcribed-with-convention.
Strand positions (50 mm grid, 60 mm top strands) are not part of the gross section.
